name: Showcase
description: An interactive container for previewing UI across viewports (desktop, tablet, mobile), with a toolbar for device switching, custom controls, and code snippets.

classes.ayy-showcase: Root container: flex column holding the header and preview stage.
classes.ayy-showcase__header: Top bar containing the title and action controls.
classes.ayy-showcase__title: Title or label for the previewed component or screen.
classes.ayy-showcase__actions: Cluster of action controls (device switcher, props, copy button).
classes.ayy-showcase__stage: The canvas holding the previewed element, with a line border, card radius, and an ambient dot pattern.
classes.ayy-showcase__viewport: The responsive viewport container that smoothly transitions width.

default.looks: A surface container with a line border, card radius, and a subtle pattern on the preview stage.

hover.none: Container; interactive elements inside handle hover.

pressed.none: Container; interactive controls handle active states.

focus.none: Not directly focusable; child controls receive focus.

sizes.width: Fills its container width; the viewport transitions max-inline-size to match the active device.

js: showcaseClass, showcaseHeaderClass, showcaseTitleClass, showcaseActionsClass, showcaseStageClass, showcaseBodyClass, showcaseDevices constants; showcaseViewportClass({ device?, className? }) → string.

react.import: import { Showcase, ShowcaseHeader, ShowcaseTitle, ShowcaseActions, ShowcaseStage, ShowcaseViewport, ShowcaseBody } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

a11y: Give the Showcase an aria-labelledby pointing to its ShowcaseTitle.
Device switchers must have accessible labels describing the active viewport.
do: Use Showcase to demonstrate component variations and responsive layouts in docs and style guides.
Use the device switcher when previewing components with distinct phone or tablet layouts.
dont: Don't hardcode fixed heights that balloon small inline components.
Don't show device controls for components with no responsive variation.
